title: French Government Holds Emergency Platform Meetings
excerpt: France calls emergency meetings with tech platforms to address protest footage, AI images, and the sale of looted goods.
body_html:
The French government has convened emergency meetings with various online platforms in response to ongoing protests. Officials instructed companies, including TikTok, to limit the spread of protest videos and artificial intelligence-altered images.

Additionally, online marketplaces such as eBay and Vinted have reportedly signed an agreement designed to prevent looted goods from appearing on their resale platforms.
